name: Rick Arrowsmith
original_name: リック・アロースミス
source:
Butler of the Fortenmayer House. He serves Selma under the order of Land Fortenmayer. Due to his somewhat calm and optimistic personality, he is often seen as a soft man, yet he does not show any mercy to enemies. Both of his parents are dead. His past had various specific circumstances. His favorite gun is called the Whistle of Dark Peril, also known as Bale Hawter. It is a specific magical gun, holding its own will and able to even engage in conversation.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/will_0114/]DMMStore[/url]]
